title: US distributor of China’s most popular humanoid robots pivots after US ban
summary: The company RoboStore had previously become the main North American distributor for humanoid robots and quadruped robots from Unitree Robotics, a Chinese robotics company that produces some of the most affordable and popular humanoid robot models.
